sloka: विचित्य वनदुर्गाणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च ।अनासाद्य पदं देव्याः प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यताः ।। ५.३५.५९।।।।
transliteration: vicitya vanadurgāṇi giriprasravaṇāni ca ।anāsādya padaṁ devyāḥ prāṇāṁstyaktuṁ samudyatāḥ ।। 5.35.59।।।।

translations.english: "We decided to give up our lives since we were unable to see the feet of the queen (Sita) even after searching the forest fortresses and the (banks of) mountain streams.
